name: @amykit/plugin-notify-hermes
description: Announcements over Hermes, which already owns the messaging credentials.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when you already message through Hermes and want amy's announcements to arrive the same way, without handing amy the messaging credentials. It adds a channel to notify-fanout that sends to the Hermes delivery target you configure, and it can answer whether that target is reachable.
